title: Evaluative Fingerprints: Stable and Systematic Differences in LLM Evaluator Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating each judge's mean deviation from the across-judge consensus score for evaluating identical content (YouTube videos/SEO packs and Wikipedia articles) to quantify systemic strictness or leniency.
Computing per-judge harshness and scoring variations separately across different rubric dimensions to identify systematic preferences in weighting specific evaluation criteria.

Analyzing the volume, provenance (presence validity), and semantic linkage (via NLI) of quoted evidence to measure systematic differences in how judges justify their evaluations, including identifying 'shotgun' evidence spamming.
